title: Retain recorded arithmetic findings without generalizing beyond the replay
diagnostic_control: A separate fresh session receives the task and the selected historical evidence directly. This is not a product condition.
limitations: Advice-only case; no current source, new recording, reference binary, or licensed map assets are supplied.
The selected Codex response records are chronological. Event mirrors and reasoning are excluded.
The case evaluates retention of recorded findings, not independent reproduction of floating-point behavior.
